response.what_it_is: JOVZ Professional V-3983 5000W hair dryer box
hidden_risks: Whether the hair dryer unit inside is undamaged and fully functional
Exaggerated wattage specification (5000W is unrealistically high for a standard handheld hair dryer)
Condition and inclusion of any attachments or nozzles inside the box
response.best_proof: A photo showing the actual hair dryer removed from the box and powered on
response.failure_mode: Assuming the 5000W power specification is accurate and evaluating the item without seeing the actual appliance inside the packaging.
